author: ShiftieNiftie
body: I was using soundboard ONCE and I was immediately banned from the Avicus Server. I don't use the soundboard anymore and I just want to play and talk with other Avicus players. Please appeal the ban I have already sent in an appeal, but no one did anything about it.
